provenance.key:
Load-bearing walls on the north and east elevations are in good condition with no visible
cracking or deflection. The steel lintel above the garage opening shows surface oxidation
but no section loss. Foundation walls are dry with no evidence of water intrusion or
efflorescence. Slab-on-grade is level within acceptable tolerances.

Main panel is a 200A Square D with 30 of 40 spaces occupied. All breakers tested and
holding. GFCI protection is present in the kitchen, bathrooms, and exterior outlets. Arc-fault
breakers are installed on bedroom circuits per 2020 NEC. Smoke detectors are hardwired
with battery backup in all required locations.

Forced-air gas furnace (Carrier, 80k BTU, 96% AFUE) installed 2022. Central AC condenser
(Carrier, 3-ton, SEER 16) appears original to the 2019 build. Ductwork is insulated flex in
the attic; no visible damage or disconnections. Filter is clean. Thermostat is a Nest Learning
model, responsive.

Architectural shingles are in good condition with no missing tabs or exposed underlayment.
Flashing at the chimney and vent pipes is sealed. Gutters and downspouts are clear and
directing water away from the foundation. Fascia and soffit are intact with no signs of pest
intrusion.
